purpose: THE SHAPE OF A SCHEDULE K-1, DECLARED ONCE. This file says what a K-1 *can say* - its boxes, its code tables, its revision. It says nothing about where any figure goes, because that depends on which return is being prepared: the same box is an INPUT to a 1040 and an OUTPUT of a Form 1065. Routes belong to a map; shape belongs here.
why_it_is_separate: The three K-1s carry 408 of the 828 routes in the 1040 map - half of it is K-1 consumption. A second map (Form 1065) would declare the same 443 codes again, and two independent declarations of a 443-code table diverge. This project has already drifted on exactly that three times: three id conventions for one K-1 (k1-1065 / k-1-1065 / schedule-k-1), four declared facts for one foreign-tax election, and two address forms ('12 code B' against '12.B') that blinded the double-count guard. The divergence is invisible until a figure lands on the wrong line.
the_seam: A Form 1065 map PRODUCES these documents; the 1040 map CONSUMES them. That is the only thing that crosses between the two returns, and it is why the boundary is drawn here rather than anywhere else.
consumed_as: document (an input with boxes) - the 1040 map
produced_as: form (an output with computed lines) - a Form 1065 / 1120-S / 1041 map

documents.notes: PARTIAL DECLARATION — only the capital boxes. Every other box belongs to the pass-through part of the map. Boxes 9b and 9c are rate-character breakouts of the long-term gain and feed the rate worksheets, not Schedule D's net — see aggregate 'k1-1065.9a'. **A K-1 ORDINARILY BELONGS ON THE RECIPIENT'S RETURN** - the entity issues it, the partner reports it - and `belongs_to_this_return` is for the exception: a K-1 in the packet whose recipient is somebody else. One measured packet held a trust's K-1 for 5,475 beside the taxpayer's own for 5,476, one dollar apart, and rental income doubled. The hold is declared on the DOCUMENT and not on each route: the 414 K-1 routes would each carry an identical conjunct, 414 places that must agree, and a route added later without it places another person's money.

documents.self_describing: This form prints its own 'Report on' column on page 2, naming the destination line for every box and code. It is the only K-1 that does, and it is the only one that came back with ZERO routing errors under independent re-derivation. The other two hide their destinations in a separate 36-page instruction PDF and carried fifteen errors between them. Distance from the printed word is the variable.

verified.by: verify_interface.py — every box number, every box label, every code letter and every Reserved marking searched for in both renderings of the form and of its instructions

frozen.how_to_change: Edit, re-run verify_interface.py until clean, then `python3 freeze_interface.py <next version>`. build.py errors (E15) on a changed shape with an unchanged hash, so a silent edit cannot reach a consumer.
